title: The Advanced Player of the Tutorial Tower
altTitles: The Tutorial Tower of the Advanced Player
チュートリアル塔の廃人
ผู้เล่นขั้นเทพแห่งหอคอยฝึกสอน
description: Hyeon-U Kim has been trapped inside the Tutorial Tower for more than twelve years, fighting endlessly against monsters that constantly regenerate. After finally escaping, he discovers that the outside world has changed dramatically. Possessing overwhelming strength and years of experience, Hyeon-U sets out to uncover why he was imprisoned while dealing with the monsters and threats that have appeared in the world.
author: Bangguseok Gimssi
